versions.subject: Merge PR #5192 from @whichbuffer - Add `Kalambur Backdoor Curl TOR SOCKS Proxy Execution`
versions.detection:
selection_img:
    Image|endswith: '\curl.exe'
selection_socks:
    CommandLine|contains:
        - 'socks5h://'
        - 'socks5://'
        - 'socks4a://'
selection_onion:
    CommandLine|contains: '.onion'
condition: all of selection_*
